title: XERGY Solar Outdoor Rope Lights- 50 LED, Auto on/Off, Waterproof Flexible Tube Fairy Lights with 8 Lighting Modes & 8 Hours Timer for Garden, Home, Party & Festival Decoration (5 Meter, Warm White)
description: Solar Powered with Auto ON/OFF Convenience- Equipped with an efficient solar panel, these rope lights automatically charge during the day using sunlight and turn ON at dusk and OFF at dawn. No wiring or electricity cost required, making it an eco-friendly and hassle-free lighting solution for everyday outdoor decoration. 8 Dynamic Lighting Modes for Versatile Decoration- Enjoy 8 different lighting effects including combination, waves, sequential, slow glow, chasing, slow fade, twinkle, and steady ON. Easily switch modes to match different occasions like parties, festivals, romantic evenings, or daily home décor. Smart 8-Hour Timer for Energy Efficiency- Built-in timer function ensures the lights stay illuminated for up to 8 hours after activation, providing consistent brightness throughout the night while optimizing battery usage for longer lifespan and reliable performance. IP65 Waterproof & All-Weather Durable- Designed with high-quality waterproof materials, these lights can withstand rain, dust, and harsh outdoor conditions. Perfect for year-round use in gardens, patios, balconies, pathways, fences, and outdoor events without worry. Flexible 5 Meter Rope Tube Design- The durable and flexible tube design allows you to easily bend, shape, and wrap the lights around trees, railings, poles, or decorative setups. Ideal for creative DIY decoration and enhancing the visual appeal of any space. Warm White Glow for Cozy Ambiance- Emits a soft and elegant warm white light that creates a relaxing and welcoming atmosphere. Perfect for home décor, festive celebrations, weddings, Diwali, Christmas, or special occasions.
